questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘(?)’ in the following equation, if ‘×’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

88 ÷ 7 × 4 − 21 + 3 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘×’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

88 ÷ 7 × 4 − 21 + 3 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

88 + 7 − 4 × 21 ÷ 3 = ?

⇒ 88 + 7 − **4 × 21 ÷ 3**__ = ?

​⇒ __**88 + 7**__ − 28

​⇒​ 95 - 28 = 67

​Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

'E + M' means 'E is the sister of M',

'E $ M' means 'E is the mother of M',

'E @ M' means 'E is the brother of M' and

'E * M' means 'E is the father of M'.

Based on the above, how is T related to O if 'T @ V * I @ O'?

V * I: V is the father of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff47738cbdf8c737500e9bdf039e66b54b0bca35d25e7820647260896f405074.png]

questions.question:

In row 1 – M, A, R and K are seated and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – P, O, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

T faces the one sitting to the immediate right of M. Only one person sits between T and P. Only two people sit between O and P. P faces the one sitting second to the left of K. R sits at some place to the right of A.

Which of the following options represents both people sitting at the extreme ends of the rows?
questions.solution:
**Given**: Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – M, A, R and K are seated
 and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – P, O, S and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

T faces the one sitting to the immediate right of M. Only one person sits between T and P.

Only two people sit between O and P. P faces the one sitting second to the left of K.

R sits at some place to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48b3fdcbb67d1eb7b69372245fa14ec9eb978b23ad70ef759e9b4d42b70bee7e.png]

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some wood are chairs.

All chairs are tables.

No table is a bed.

Conclusions:

(I): Some wood are table.

(II): All chairs are beds.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

Some wood are chairs.

All chairs are tables.

No table is a bed.

The least possible venn diagram of the given statement is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c246e0c0c5405cba09f52ff01bd0a839e115903c89e6124cdc7bdbd1a33743.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some wood are table - **True**(because, some chair are wood and all chair are table, it implies that some wood are table as well).

(II): All chairs are beds - **False**(because, all chair are table and no table is bed, it implies that no chair is bed).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
